extDescription.message: Block distracting and harmful sites in one click. Unblocking takes time, on purpose.

blockDefaultReason.message: You chose to keep this out.

popupNotAWebsite.message: Hammer of Clarity can only block websites.

categorySocialDescription.message: Feeds built to keep you scrolling.

categoryShortVideoDescription.message: Shorts, Reels and TikTok. The rest of YouTube stays open.

categorySitesHint.message: Untick any site you need. After this, taking a site out takes a day.

redirectDefaultWater.message: Drink a glass of water and do 20 push-ups.

redirectDefaultWrite.message: Write down what you are feeling right now.

settingsRedirectsHint.message: When you hit a wall, one of these is offered at random.

redirectInvalid.message: Add some text, and a web address starting with https:// for links.

removalSectionHint.message: The wall stays up while a request waits. Changed your mind? Cancel any time.

removalConfirmBefore.message: Confirm before $TIME$, or the request lapses.

removalWrongText.message: That is not the same text. Take your time.

removalFixedSentence.message: I am choosing to remove this wall, and I accept what comes with it.

popupRemovalWaiting.message: A removal request is waiting in settings.

resetBody.message: A slip does not undo what you have learned.

incognitoWarning.message: Incognito windows are not covered yet. Allow Hammer of Clarity in incognito so your walls hold there too.

graduationAnnouncement.message: $CATEGORY$ has graduated: you are trusted here now.

graduationExplain.message: Removing a wall here no longer has a waiting period. You will still type your reason.

categoryListHint.message: Uses a large, maintained public list, so there is nothing to tick. Lists sometimes catch the wrong site; you can let one through later.

wronglyBlockedHint.message: Ask to let it through. It takes a day and your reason, like any removal, but it never sets this category back.

wronglyBlockedInvalid.message: That is not a site address, or it is already let through.

listsRefreshLabel.message: Keep the adult and gambling lists up to date

listsRefreshHint.message: Once a week, the latest public lists are downloaded from their maintainers, OISD and HaGeZi. Nothing about you is sent. Turn this off to stay fully offline.

listsBundled.message: Using the lists that came with the extension.

onboardingWelcomeBody.message: Blocking a site takes one click. Unblocking takes a day and your own words, on purpose: long enough for an urge to pass.

onboardingCategoriesTitle.message: What do you want to keep out?

onboardingCategoriesBody.message: Pick any you like, or none for now. You can also block single sites from the toolbar at any time.

onboardingCategoriesNote.message: Turning these off later takes time.

onboardingRedirectsBody.message: When you hit a wall, one of these is offered. Keep the suggestions or make them your own.

onboardingIncognitoBody.message: Chrome does not run extensions in incognito unless you allow it, so without this every wall has a side door. Only you can switch it on.

onboardingIncognitoHow.message: Open the setting, switch on "Allow in Incognito", then come back to this tab.

onboardingDoneBody.message: To block the site you are on, click the hammer in the toolbar. Settings are there too.

creditsLicence.message: Hammer of Clarity is free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3.

creditsSource.message: Its source code, including the full licence text, is published with the extension.

creditsListsHint.message: The adult and gambling categories use these community-maintained lists. Thank you to their maintainers.

siteAccessWarning.message: Your walls are down: Hammer of Clarity can only block sites when its site access is set to "On all sites".
